summary: All 8 Phase 14 criteria (JRN-168..176 + deferred P13 JRN-165 widget runtime) pass in the browser at localhost:3000, plus one ingress smoke run through the preview URL. Backend lane skipped: the app is a frontend-only mocked prototype (per briefing). The builder script scripts/phase14-check.mjs also ran with no FAIL lines.

notes.title: Phone tap targets: spec conflict between 40px and 44px
notes.evidence: At 390x844 the floating controls measure widget-cart 40x40, widget-track 138x40, widget-close 40x40 and widget-send 40x40. The AI notice link measures 49x24. REQ-779 says the controls are 40px, but journeys.md line 72 asks for tap targets of at least 44px on phone. Decide which spec wins. If 44px is meant to apply, the widget.css .gw-float buttons and the composer send button need a phone/coarse-pointer size bump.

notes.title: Top fade on scroll not asserted visually
notes.evidence: The conversation body (gw-body) scrolls (scrollHeight 510 vs clientHeight 467). The fade is a CSS gradient on .gw-float, which can only be confirmed from a screenshot, so it was not asserted programmatically.

checks.name: p14-launcher-home
checks.evidence: Launcher 64px, white bg, box-shadow; badge and greeting bubble visible. Panel 400px wide, 28px radius, backdrop blur, no widget-header. Cart/Track orders/Close are 40px. Starters in order; See last conversation absent; 'Ask anything' input with attach icon; footer 'AI notice • Privacy'.

checks.name: p14-launcher-home-ingress
checks.evidence: https://goorin-inbox.preview.emergentagent.com/widget-demo: launcher opens the panel, starters render.

checks.name: p14-conversation-feedback
checks.evidence: Typing indicator shows, then the AI reply. Back arrow present; placeholder 'Reply'. AI text has a transparent bg and no avatar. Customer pill is right-aligned. Thumb up aria-pressed with bg rgb(31,29,26); down switches; down again clears.

checks.criterion: JRN-170 + P13 JRN-165 Starter actions and workflow runtime
checks.name: p14-starter-actions-runtime
checks.evidence: Track orders and 'Where is my order?' both ask 'What email did you use'. Email leads to a 6-digit code in widget-mock-inbox-body, with 0 orders before the code. After the code, widget-run-order-GB20398 and 'Track package' appear. Cart drawer opens. Wholesale gets an AI wholesale reply. Close/reopen shows See last conversation. With wf-order-tracking Off, 'has my order shipped' gets the AI reply 'I found order #GB20411...'.

checks.criterion: JRN-171 AI notice, handoff, offline, CSAT, pre-chat
checks.name: p14-notice-handoff-states-prechat
checks.evidence: Notice sheet text and Privacy verified. 'talk to a person' gives 'Connecting you with our team…'. Demo Offline and CSAT states render. No pre-chat by default; with ws-ask-email On, clicking a starter in the Channels preview shows widget-prechat (Email/Name/Order number/Start chat).

checks.name: p14-channels-layout-preview
checks.evidence: Tabs exactly Chat/Contact form/Email/Installation; no Appearance/Preferences. Settings form ≤660px. Sections in order: branding, launcher, home, conversation, display, csat. Preview is sticky with no preview-on-store and no 'On my store'. Panel open on home/active_chat/order_tracking. Outside hours shows offline. Mobile frame works. Caption matches.

checks.name: p14-look-launcher-conversation-settings
checks.evidence: Hex field ≤140px with popover picker. Solid sets backdrop-filter none and Frosted sets it back to blur. Font inherit changes the font-family. Help icon changes the closed launcher. Top-left moves the launcher. Spacing 24/24 applies. 'Unsaved changes' turns to 'All changes saved' after Save. Bot rename shows in the preview; thumbs off hides widget-thumbs. Leaving unsaved shows the 'Discard unsaved changes?' dialog.

checks.name: p14-starters-editor
checks.evidence: Cart toggle off hides widget-cart. Track renamed to 'Track my order' in the pill. Size help with Hat size finder (Off) shows the off note. Empty label gives 'Add a label.'; bad URL gives 'Enter a valid URL.'. Move-down reorders the preview; delete removes it. At 8 starters the add button is disabled with the limit text.

checks.criterion: JRN-176 Focus ring, phone, access, regressions
checks.name: p14-focus-phone-a11y-isolation
checks.evidence: Mouse click shows outline none and no box-shadow; keyboard Tab is :focus-visible with a 2px solid ring. axe (wcag2a/aa) on /widget-demo with the panel open: 0 serious/critical. Hostile CSS toggle leaves panel font/radius/width and input style unchanged. At 390 the panel is 390x844 at y=0 with the float bar. Channels shows the Preview button and its sheet opens. No horizontal overflow. Targets: controls 40px (see note).
